entry.subheadline: Explore farming plans before committing your land, water, inputs, and money. Evaluate crop yields, net profit, and water risk with transparent agronomic simulation.
entry.workflowDesc: From farm definition to scenario comparison, test every decision before spending your money.
entry.step1Desc: Define total acreage, village location, soil type, and available water reserves.
entry.step2Desc: Choose crop variety, sowing date, irrigation method (drip/flood), and input budget multiplier.
entry.step3Desc: Deterministic engines compute expected yield range, net profit, water requirement, and risk score.
entry.step4Desc: Evaluate up to 4 plans side-by-side to understand trade-offs before buying seeds and inputs.
entry.compareDesc: Every plan evaluates 5 core dimensions so you see both physical and economic trade-offs.
entry.metricYieldDesc: Quintals produced based on water & sowing dates.
entry.metricProfitDesc: Revenue minus input costs and irrigation expenses.
entry.metricWaterDesc: Total m³ needed vs farm water reserves.
entry.metricRiskDesc: Composite weather, delay, and financial risk score.
entry.metricRoiDesc: Return on investment ratio for budget allocation.
entry.whyDesc: No AI hallucinations. No fake claims. Governed strictly by published agronomic research.
entry.whyTransparentDesc: All model formulas, crop parameters, and research references are publicly inspectable.
entry.whyDeterministicDesc: Zero random guessing. Given the same farm inputs, the simulation yields identical results.
entry.whyExplainableDesc: Factor attribution engine answers exactly 'Why did my profit or yield change?'
entry.whyResourceDesc: Verifies capital, seed stock, and water reserves to prevent unfeasible plan commitments.
entry.finalCtaTitle: Ready to test your next farming plan?
entry.finalCtaDesc: Create your farm profile, test seasonal crop alternatives, and optimize your profit before planting.
